title: Meals You Can't Miss

chapters.description: Sweet-and-savoury empanadas filled with meat and potato broth
Breaded beef cutlet over rice, potatoes, and egg
Spicy mix of beef, sausage, french fries, and veggies

editorial: We can’t objectively review Bolivian cuisine as we were famished by the time our food arrived (because of painfully slow service in most restaurants)! Restaurant timings in Uyuni are unpredictable, so be ready to dash from one place to another in search of food.
Street bread was perhaps the highlight of the trip on account of how delicious and inexpensive it was (around $0.30 for a meal-sized loaf).
